name: distribution-ingress-rate
description: Publisher side, the ingress. Gateway POST /d/{distribution_id}/rate. Resolves the distributor from the server-stamped route param (a caller cannot forge it, and an msr- key is scoped to one concrete path), applies the declared-field allowlist, enforces (quote_id, version) idempotency, mints the immutable submission, runs flow 1 and projects the decision back. config.result names PREPARE -- the last node EVERY branch reaches -- so a replay or a refusal cannot 504 an awaited submit; the decision itself reaches the broker on their own outcome record, which is what section 1.7's UX expects.
